summary: Backend-only testing of JADE OS API. Created /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covering health, auth, leads CRUD + auth gating, agent chat SSE, extract (healthcare/saas/manufacturing), extract-bol backcompat, draft-outreach (healthcare+freight tone), qualify-lead, NEW support-triage (ecommerce+legal), admin stats and admin agent-runs. 30/30 tests passed in ~61s against the public preview URL.

minor.issue: JWT_SECRET in .env is the placeholder 'jade-os-prod-secret-rotate-me-please' — should be rotated before prod.
Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — works fine but emits DeprecationWarning; consider lifespan context manager.
status_value is taken as query param via PATCH /api/leads/{id}?status_value=... — unconventional; consider body model. Functional.

action_items: Optional: rotate JWT_SECRET in /app/backend/.env to a strong random value.
Optional: migrate startup/shutdown to FastAPI lifespan API to silence DeprecationWarnings.
Optional: accept JSON body in PATCH /api/leads/{id} instead of query string for status_value.
critical_code_review_comments: AgentRun.agent_type Literal correctly includes 'extract' and 'support_triage' — verified via /api/admin/agent-runs after running the suite.
INDUSTRY_LEXICON + _system_for properly inject industry-specific vocabulary; chat/outreach responses for healthcare did NOT include freight terms (bol/lane/freight broker) — industry tuning works.
Extract endpoint streams LLM output and json.loads(_strip_json(...)) — robust to markdown fences. Returns {'raw', 'parse_error': True} on parse failure (good fallback).
Mongo _id is excluded from all reads via projections — good.
EmailStr validation enforced on Lead/LeadCreate — good.
POST /api/leads is intentionally public (no auth) per spec — confirmed working for all 11 verticals.
JWT expiry is 7 days; consider shorter + refresh tokens in future.
seed_data_creation: Created ~13 TEST_-prefixed lead records (11 verticals + 1 patch + 1 list-check seed). They remain in the leads collection but are clearly marked with TEST_ prefix in name/company.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints in the review request pass. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is the regression suite — re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. SSE chat helper is in _consume_sse. LLM calls take 5-30s each; full suite ~60s. If you add new agent_type values, update the AgentRun Literal in /app/backend/server.py.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Previous testing agent had reported no actual runs; this iteration ran the complete pytest suite against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and verified all status codes, response shapes, industry-aware behavior, SSE streaming and admin auth gating.
